vendor.blurb: Open-source coding flagship lab; GLM-5.3 is top-tier open weights, pushing its Coding Plan

glm-5-3.tagline: One of the best open-weights coding agents
highlights: AA Intelligence Index 45, #2 among open weights, tied with Qwen3.8 Max
LMArena Text #24 (1480), Code #18 (1619)
CyberGym 84.5%; Z.ai says it found 2,436 vulnerabilities in real projects
glm-5-3.notes: Post-training only, on the same base as 5.2. Coding Plan 8/14, API 8/18, weights 8/28 (not MIT). In September, ZCode drew a code-upload controversy.

glm-5-3-flash.tagline: Bargain native multimodal, a local-run favorite
highlights: First natively multimodal GLM-5 model: image, video and document input
AA Intelligence Index 42, just 3 below full GLM-5.3
LMArena Code 1613 (#21), Text 1474 (#35)
MIT license; Sentdex reports 4B+ tokens run locally
glm-5-3-flash.notes: Anonymous codename Ox Alpha. The faster GLM-5.3-FlashX (up to 200 tok/s, 2.5x the price) is folded in here. Some users say it's slower than the standard model.

glm-5-2.tagline: The last-gen flagship that hit 1M context
highlights: AA index 51 at launch (v4.1), #1 among open weights
Context up from GLM-5.1's 200K to 1M
LMArena Code 1602 (#22), Text 1476 (#31)
glm-5-2.notes: Shares its base with GLM-5.3. Z.ai says long-horizon coding falls between Opus 4.7 and 4.8. Token use per task runs high (about 43k).

highlights: SWE-Bench Pro 58.4, beat GPT-5.4 and Opus 4.6 at launch
MIT license; Z.ai says it can run autonomously for 8 hours
LMArena Code 1508, now down to #49
glm-5-1.notes: Superseded by 5.2 and 5.3 within six months; now mostly an open-weights baseline.

glm-5.tagline: The base model that started the GLM-5 family
highlights: First to adopt DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) for long-context token efficiency
Z.ai benchmarks its code logic density against Claude Opus 4.5
LMArena Text 1457 (#61), Code 1434 (#72)
glm-5.notes: MIT-licensed open weights; 5.1, 5.2 and 5.3 all reuse the same MoE scale.

glm-5v-turbo.tagline: A screenshot-to-code vision agent, now retired
highlights: Z.ai's first natively multimodal agent base: image, video and text input
Built for screenshot/mockup-to-code and browser agents
LMArena Code 1400, #81
glm-5v-turbo.notes: Closed, API only; removed from the Z.ai price list as of September 2026. Its vision capabilities now live in the natively multimodal GLM-5.3-Flash.

glm-image.tagline: Open image gen that knows things
highlights: Hybrid: autoregressive semantic understanding plus diffusion decoding
Z.ai pitches it for knowledge-heavy scenes and in-image text
MIT-licensed; LMArena text-to-image 1012, #74
glm-image.notes: Well behind frontier image models; listed because it's Z.ai's only current image model and it's open.
